label: Margaritas Mexican Restaurant (Tex-Mex)
note: Five portrait photos from a ten-page booklet: p1 cover (logo + QR code, no dishes — the restaurant name is ONLY here), p2 nachos/appetizers/à la carta/extras, p3 margaritas & cocktails (alcohol), p6 burritos/chimichangas/street tacos, p7 house specials/enchiladas/quesadillas. Busy design: textured background, dish photos with captions that repeat dish names ('FAJITA NACHOS', 'TAQUITOS', 'QUESO FUNDIDO', 'BURRITO AZABACHE', 'BURRITO BOWL', 'FAJITAS CHIMICHANGA', 'STREET TACOS', 'POLLO WITH VEGGIES', 'CARNITAS', 'ENCHILADAS SUPREMAS', 'QUESABIRRIA'), award ribbons, and a vertical tab down the page edge listing section names — none of which are dishes. Extras other than French fries are add-ons. The PDF text layer has 'DEL G0LFO' with a zero; the printed page reads GOLFO. Cover page tests isMenu on a page with no items.
